scheme_name: Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan
Applicant must be either a war widow of a martyr or a parent of an unmarried martyr who died before 31 March 1999
benefits_summary: A lifelong financial assistance of ₹5,000 per month is deposited directly into the beneficiary’s bank account.
